cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)

project("iperf_jni")

# Configure iperf build options
add_definitions(-DHAVE_CONFIG_H)
add_definitions(-D_GNU_SOURCE)
add_definitions(-DWITHOUT_OPENSSL)

# Reproducible builds (F-Droid): strip absolute build paths and the
# non-deterministic GNU build-id from the native library.
add_compile_options("-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}=.")
add_link_options("LINKER:--build-id=none")

# Include directories
# iperf_android/ holds:
#  - the checked-in iperf_config.h + version.h (normally generated by ./configure)
#  - RF-REAPR patched copies of cjson.c, iperf_error.c and iperf_pthread.c (JNI-safe:
#    longjmp instead of exit(), idempotent signal handler, cJSON cast fixes)
# so the build works from a clean checkout of the UNMODIFIED upstream iperf3 submodule.
include_directories(iperf_android iperf3/src)

# iperf3 source files
set(IPERF3_SOURCES
    iperf_android/cjson.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_api.c
    iperf_android/iperf_error.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_auth.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_client_api.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_locale.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_server_api.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_tcp.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_udp.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_sctp.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_util.c
    iperf3/src/iperf_time.c
    iperf_android/iperf_pthread.c
    iperf3/src/dscp.c
    iperf3/src/net.c
    iperf3/src/tcp_info.c
    iperf3/src/timer.c
    iperf3/src/units.c
)

# Build a shared library combining iperf3 and JNI wrapper
add_library(
        iperf_jni
        SHARED
        iperf_jni.cpp
        ${IPERF3_SOURCES}
)

find_library(
        log-lib
        log
)

target_link_libraries(
        iperf_jni
        ${log-lib}
)

# Fix for 16 KB page size compatibility (Android 15+)
set_target_properties(iperf_jni PROPERTIES LINK_FLAGS "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384")
